name: domain.trajectory_auditor
description: Agent trajectory step auditor, repetitive loop / stuck detector, and recovery prompt synthesizer

entrypoints.name: audit_trajectory_steps
entrypoints.description: Analyze an agent's execution history for repeated tool failures, excessive step counts, and inefficiency

entrypoints.name: detect_repetitive_loop
entrypoints.description: Detect cyclic repetition in agent action sequences (e.g. A -> B -> A -> B)

parameters.name: actions
parameters.description: Sequential list of tool action strings

entrypoints.name: synthesize_recovery_prompt
entrypoints.description: Generate an intervention prompt to break an agent out of a stuck loop or error cycle

parameters.name: stuck_reason
parameters.description: Description of detected error or repeating pattern

parameters.name: last_failed_action
parameters.description: Name of action that repeatedly failed
